text.ja: 本例のために導出した周期2D VETの連続Fourier応答 For k>0: R=atan(k/st)/k, A=b/(1-ss*R), B=(1-st*R)/k, C=st*(1-st*R)/k^2, T=(R-C)/2. E=E0+Re(sum A*R*exp(i*k.x)); H=Re(sum -i*A*B*khat*exp(i*k.x)); K=E0*I3/3+Re(sum A*(T*I3+(C-T)*khat*khat^T)*exp(i*k.x)); D=K/E; E0=qmean/(st-ss). 静止・定常・灰色の単位周期正方形。σt=4、σs=3、σa=1、c=1の無次元点値。q=1+0.3 cos(2πx)+0.2 sin(2π(x+y))。空間は2Dでも角度は全S²でDzzも保持します。 正の指定等方輻射源を使い、角度空間は球面S²を保ちます。
text.en: Authored continuum Fourier response for periodic 2D VET For k>0: R=atan(k/st)/k, A=b/(1-ss*R), B=(1-st*R)/k, C=st*(1-st*R)/k^2, T=(R-C)/2. E=E0+Re(sum A*R*exp(i*k.x)); H=Re(sum -i*A*B*khat*exp(i*k.x)); K=E0*I3/3+Re(sum A*(T*I3+(C-T)*khat*khat^T)*exp(i*k.x)); D=K/E; E0=qmean/(st-ss). Static steady grey unit-periodic square; dimensionless st=4, ss=3, sa=1 and c=1, using point samples. q=1+0.3 cos(2pi x)+0.2 sin(2pi(x+y)). Space is2D, but directions cover full S2 and Dzz is retained. Positive prescribed isotropic source; physical angle space remains S2.
